title: Paid newsletter analytics for independent writers
thesis: Writers want to understand their readers and would pay for analytics.
note: The evidence actively says they will not pay.

evidence.title: Writer states they will not pay for analytics
evidence.body: I would not pay for this. The platform already shows me opens and that is enough.

evidence.title: Platform ships it free
evidence.body: The hosting platform added the same analytics at no extra cost for every paid plan.

evidence.title: Second writer says the same
evidence.body: Nice to have, but I write for two hundred people. What would I do differently?
